reviewed_properties.conclusion: resultBytes_ remains the identical uninitialized std::byte array with identical alignas and extent. State pointer, receipt/failureTail copies, Exchange atomic DMI and three bool initializations keep their mutual order. The earlier raw-array lifetime adds no initialization write or runtime action.

Same sponsored placement construction, launder access, resultLive_ transitions, explicit pre-drop destruction and separate PlanOwner lifetime. Actual terminal acquire, finite take and no freed-State tail access remain unchanged.

Complete corresponding source retains State without worker/result reverse ownership, worker-local staging, one same-origin detached Result, maximum3 live origin references and sequential Result-drop then Retained/Reader possibility. Outer slots remain raw and explicitly constructed/destroyed. These facts do not certify numeric complete lifetime coverage.

Protected exact old-callee amount remains same-origin, branchless commit remains immediately before guaranteed actual old entry. No copied price/slack claim is made.

All corresponding root/capture/quote/three-builder/guard/refusal/error/cancellation/cleanup, native bootstrap and region/access walks, selector/restoration, monotone prefix and endpoint prediction, exact old-callee composition and reconciliation bodies are preserved in full. Five files are byte-identical; formation differs only in field order. Existing conditional functional acceptance corresponds to R5 without broadening its proof domain.
